title: Binance Will Add First Neiro on Ethereum (NEIRO), Turbo (TURBO) and Baby Doge Coin (1MBABYDOGE) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert & Margin
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  First Neiro on Ethereum (NEIRO), Turbo (TURBO) and Baby Doge Coin (1MBABYDOGE)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin  and  Binance Auto-Invest  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn Simple Earn Flexible will list  First Neiro on Ethereum (NEIRO) ,  Turbo (TURBO)  and  Baby Doge Coin (1MBABYDOGE)   on Binance Simple Earn at  2024-09-16 10:00 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . From  2024-09-17 10:00 (UTC) , users may purchase NEIRO, TURBO and 1MBABYDOGE using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  NEIRO, TURBO, 1MBABYDOGE  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay,  or buy and sell with their  wallet balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  NEIRO ,  TURBO ,  1MBABYDOGE  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading NEIRO, TURBO and 1MBABYDOGE against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of NEIRO, TURBO and 1MBABYDOGE being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add NEIRO, TURBO and 1MBABYDOGE as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  NEIRO/USDT ,  TURBO/USDT  and  1MBABYDOGE/USDT  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-09-16 11:00 (UTC) Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates.
